manual_steps_required: Enable random question order in the Ratings block (Qualtrics web editor -> open Ratings block -> gear icon -> Question Randomization -> 'Randomize the order of all questions'). API does not support setting this in block PUT.
Move the age question to the top of the Demographics block (currently at bottom because it was added last via the patch script).
Replace the placeholder consent text with IRB-approved language before activating the survey.
Set the survey to Active when ready to distribute (currently Inactive).
